_meta.purpose: Equity sector -> broader macro correlation cluster, for AXIOM Hedge Layer net_correlation_bucket_exposure().
_meta.note: FX correlation buckets are NOT redefined here — for FX, the currency itself IS the correlation bucket (src/equity/trend_risk_gates.py currency_legs is the single source of truth, reused directly by src/hedge/exposure_tags.py). This map only extends the same 'correlation bucket' concept to equities, where a single ticker/sector isn't a sufficient bucket key because multiple sectors can share one macro driver (rates, commodities, growth).
_meta.fail_closed: A sector absent from this map is treated as UNKNOWN by portfolio_exposure.net_correlation_bucket_exposure — the caller fails closed.
